blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Several House of Representatives lawmakers from the National Unity Party (NUP) are pushing for a bill that seeks to create a body that would manage advanced industries in the country, like the proposed Pax Silica hub in Luzon, to provide a legal framework for such industries. During a press briefing on Monday, NUP members Deputy Speaker Ronaldo Puno, Camarines Sur Rep. Miguel Luis Villafuerte, Manila Rep. Rolando Valeriano, and Bataan Rep. Albert Garcia announced that they have filed the proposed Advanced Industries Development Act, which will set guidelines on hubs in the country. READ: PH must not squander Pax […]...
